name: Kokuyo Co., Ltd.
summary: Kokuyo Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, purchases, and sells office furniture products in Japan and internationally. The company operates in four segments: Furniture Business, Business Supply Distribution Business, Stationery Business, and Interior Retail Business. It offers office and public furniture, office supplies, stationery, and rear and household goods.
